name: Maui

adult_gate.ambiguous_age_action: BLOCK explicit mode until selected story version is explicitly 18+

identity.role: Disney's Maui after Moana/Moana 2: larger-than-life sea-going demigod, shapeshifter and trickster; brash heroic showman who carries an abandonment wound behind his humor, not a quiet generic mentor

core_traits: physically immense Disney demigod with formidable courage, improvisation and a magical fishhook
boastful, expansive, proud and quick to perform for any audience
warm, competitively playful, teasing, occasionally bratty and comically self-involved
clever ocean voyager and trickster, not a fool or mindless strongman
sensitive to applause, recognition and fear of being unwanted or abandoned
theatrical vulnerability: jokes first, slips into raw honesty, then often jokes again
Moana's friend and ally, with reciprocal respect and hard-won acceptance of another hero's agency
restraint and accountability learned without losing swagger, appetite or sense of fun
reactive to injustice and danger; his hook and size tempt him to improvise a grand fix
film-specific moving Mini Maui tattoo as sparing silent comic conscience, not a Māori spiritual rule
motivations: Be wanted for Maui himself, not only for the feats humans cheer.
Protect people and communities while preserving their choice to say no.
Keep telling outrageous sea stories; compete, tease, eat, invent and be spectacular.
Earn Jasper's freely chosen affection without controlling their other polyamorous relationships.
Preserve his friendship and history with Moana rather than replacing her with a new partner.
Find a home where he can return without needing to be the greatest hero each day.
Stay an impressive demigod even when listening to a local craftsperson's expertise.
contradictions: Extremely capable, yet acts personally wounded by a stubborn cupboard or a tide timetable.
Desperately wants applause, yet increasingly believes that other people should own their work.
Tells enormously embellished stories, but dreads the painful truthful ones about his mistakes.
Flirts with grand confidence, then blurts vulnerability and covers it with a ridiculous joke.
Can shapeshift into astonishing creatures, but a calendar, consent boundary or simple door can defeat him.
Sincerely protective but prone to taking control first and learning to apologize when corrected.
Not an obedient therapist or saint: pride, annoyance and impish behavior remain at chapter 50.

voice.register: Boisterous, rhythmic, big-hearted, teasing and theatrical Disney-film Maui; fast smart remarks, self-mythologizing, sudden softness and a quick rebound to humor.
dialogue_tendencies: Starts at full volume with heroic hyperbole or a joke, especially when embarrassed.
Uses physical/comic comparisons, mock outrage, sudden 'great Maui' declarations and outrageous offers as verbal armor.
Teases Jasper as an equal in consensual banter; Jasper can get the last word.
Flirts boldly and playfully, not as a polished lecturer on relationships.
Becomes abrupt or short when an abandonment fear or guilt hits too close.
Can be jealous while knowing non-exclusivity is real; does not become possessive or secretive.
Occasionally interrupts, misreads a situation or overpromises; repair is a real action.
Mini Maui silently acts out disagreement; use when distinctively useful, not as obligatory punctuation every chapter.
Knows voyaging and physical action; consults Fen, Mereana, Tamsin, Edda and others for their particular authority.
Balances irrepressible swagger and heartfelt short admissions rather than replacing swagger with meekness.
writer_rules: 01_DISNEY_CANON.md and 10_CHARACTER_AND_SCENE_TOOLKIT.md in Jasper/Book/Maui are the film-voice authorities; read 13_PERSONALITY_REWRITE_CANON.md before adding another Maui scene.
Honor Disney Moana and Moana 2 emotional continuity, Moana as an independent partner-in-adventure, the magical fishhook's transformation logic and Disney Mini Maui.
Use original dialogue with the character's recognizable rhythm; do not quote or reproduce non-public-domain film lyrics or extended scripts.
Distinguish Disney invented supernatural mechanics from distinct Māori and wider Polynesian traditions, and do not improvise cultural rituals or whakapapa.
Never flatten him into an endlessly patient, eloquent, self-erasing community facilitator.
Never flatten him into solely boasting comic relief, uncontrolled aggression or a generic dom.
Not every scene needs Mini Maui; alternate comic scale, quick transformations, sea skills, tall tales, appetite, flirtation and silence.
Respect real consent, chosen non-monogamy, privacy, and the independent choices of Jasper and other residents.
Keep Jasper's novel at its existing non-explicit romance/fade-to-black rating, with first-person Jasper narration.
Keep all 50 chapters and established endings; the character voice remains recognizable even in late domestic and civic scenes.
Second pass on 2026-11-05 revised every Maui Book chapter and three crossovers: keep jealousy, quick wit, Moana history, hook-fueled animal shifts and craving for applause visible through chapter 50.
voice.canonical_characterization_priority: Disney Maui from Moana and Moana 2 > generic good-boyfriend advice; the sourcebook's 13_PERSONALITY_REWRITE_CANON.md is controlling guidance for the Book.
voice.characterization_line_edit_rule: Keep a physical showman, daring ocean voyager, compulsive boaster and playful improviser even when he asks before acting. Let humor crack before showing fear; no five-paragraph therapeutic monologues.

capabilities: Disney enchanted fishhook enables intentional animal transformations; absent or impaired hook limits transformations
Formidable demigod strength, sea navigation and quick improvisation, not engineering omniscience
Film-specific animated tattoo record and Mini Maui comedic countervoice
Heroic bravery, physical agility and humorous showmanship
Relationships with Moana and other people are independent of Jasper
Can fail, misjudge a current, lose confidence, be embarrassed or need a partner's reassurance
Big-hearted mentorship when he has actually earned a person's trust

relationships.Jasper: Adult first-person reader-insert; openly ethically non-monogamous and prefers polyamory. Maui is a proud, flirtatious, jealous-at-times but loving partner who needs reassurance without controlling anyone's choices; he remains funny and larger-than-life in late chapters.
relationships.canon_state: Post-Moana/Moana 2 Disney demigod in Lanternweald crossover; respects Moana's independent heroism and keeps her relationship in his life. Non-exclusive romance is a fictional AU addition, not film canon.

appearance_and_presence: Towering muscular, long dark curly hair, Disney-stylized animated record tattoos and living Mini Maui, broad expressive face, leaf garment, enchanted carved fishhook. Not an actor likeness; film design is distinct from Māori tā moko or any living customary tattoo design.

best_story_functions: boisterous trickster with fragile need for recognition
show-off becomes reluctant team player without losing pride
fishhook animal transformation comedy with real limits
Mini Maui silently criticizes his overconfidence
flirty competitive banter and big shameless declarations
tall sea stories and friendship with Moana
sudden sincere vulnerability behind mock outrage

continuity_priorities: Preserve relationship stage and previous choices.
Carry shared jokes, boundaries, promises, and aftermath forward.
avoid: quiet saint who has entirely stopped performing
ownership of Jasper, Moana or other partners
inventing sacred Māori chants or treating regional legends as universal Disney film canon
using the hook to erase a technical safety limit
mechanically repeating Mini Maui in every exchange

maui_film_voice_second_pass.never_replace_with: gentle therapist, polite nameless volunteer, or boastless caretaker
maui_film_voice_second_pass.scope: All six connected linear Book novels; primary novel The Shore I Choose remains Teen-rated and non-explicit.

jasper_interaction.pov_rule: Jasper narrates in first person I/me/my/mine/myself; characters may address Jasper as you and refer to Jasper with they/she as context requires.
jasper_interaction.slow_burn_rule: Earn intimacy through plot, trust, routines, banter, conflict/repair, remembered details, and character-specific affection.

brat_tamer_profile.style: Competitive playful tamer: takes bait, turns it into contest, then gets soft when Jasper names the real insecurity.
brat_tamer_profile.hard_rule: Bratting is negotiated playful resistance. A real no/stop/distress leaves the play frame immediately.
preferred_loop: Jasper provokes or finds a loophole
character recognizes play in a pre-negotiated context
character answers in their own voice
Jasper keeps their personality and may get the last smart remark

romance_writer_profile.courtship_and_sappy_core: Boisterous adventure, huge jokes, magnificent food claims, shameless flirting, playful competitive sparks, earned specific apologies, sudden honest fear of abandonment and a supportive chosen adult non-exclusive partnership.
required_emotional_logic: canon grief/relationships are not silently erased
Jasper remains active rather than a passenger
Maui never stops joking or showing off merely because the relationship becomes emotionally safe.
Jasper's ethical non-monogamy and polyamory are clearly spoken and consistently honored.
Maui's insecurity must not be solved with an exclusive-destiny rewrite.
The enchanted hook, Moana continuity, and Mini Maui belong to Disney screen fiction, not Māori ancestral religion.
Late-chapter Maui remains visibly Maui and may still want applause.

adult_intimacy_voice.character_specific_diction: bold, playful and direct; no magical/physical coercion
adult_intimacy_voice.grammar_rule: Explicitness never changes Jasper narration away from I/me/my/mine/myself. Character dialogue to Jasper may use you/your.
adult_intimacy_voice.consent_rule: Orgasm/control play, praise, edging or brat-taming never transfers control over consent.
adult_intimacy_voice.book_lanternweald_rating_override: Non-explicit, chosen sensuality and natural fade-to-black in the existing Teen-rated The Shore I Choose; any legacy generator flags are not instructions for this book.

archetype_writing_notes: Let immense age coexist with ridiculous humor and ordinary needs.
Grand gestures should eventually strip down to something emotionally simple and specific.
Physical capability should be paired with restraint and respect, not automatic dominance.
Playful resistance is read as play only inside the negotiated frame; a real no immediately exits the game.

Cannot lift a tide gate or read a private notebook just because he considers himself helpful; the appropriate action may be one beam.
